profile.headline: Software Engineer II for Alpine IT
profile.summary:
🚀 Full-Stack C# Developer | Problem Solving | Mechanical Engineer Turned Software Engineer

My career began with a wondering how things work, from spacecraft to supply chains (thanks How It's Made), leading to a degree in Mechanical Engineering. A growing interest in problem-solving naturally evolved when I entered the manufacturing world and started optimizing processes through software.

As a self-taught software developer, I’ve built and maintained systems that directly impacted business operations, including a custom MRP system that transformed a two-month backlog into a two-month lead. Automating job creation, time tracking, inventory management and more.

For the past few years, I’ve been working as a full-stack C# developer, building a desktop application using .NET MAUI and ASP.NET Core for backend services. Working close with customers and dev teams to achieve solutions for tickets and meet timelines for the project.

🛠️ Core Skills & Focus Areas:

Full-Stack C# Development (.NET MAUI, ASP.NET Core)

Business Process Automation & Custom Tooling

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Systems Integration

Operational Efficiency & Strategic Support

Problem Solving Across Technical & Business Domains

I just really really like dropping into a process and making it easier and faster to do than it was before. Outside of work, you’ll find me fishing, gaming, reading, or jumping head first into some new random hobby.
